mapper.sql: EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM question q JOIN interview_round r ON r.id = q.round_id WHERE r.interview_id = i.id AND ( lower(q.content) LIKE #{kw} ESCAPE '\' OR lower(coalesce(q.algorithm_title, '')) LIKE #{kw} ESCAPE '\' OR lower(coalesce(q.algorithm_description, '')) LIKE #{kw} ESCAPE '\' OR lower(coalesce(q.algorithm_requirements, '')) LIKE #{kw} ESCAPE '\' OR lower(coalesce(q.section_label, '')) LIKE #{kw} ESCAPE '\')) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM follow_up f JOIN question q ON q.id = f.question_id JOIN interview_round r ON r.id = q.round_id WHERE r.interview_id = i.id AND lower(f.content) LIKE #{kw} ESCAPE '\') OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM company c WHERE c.id = i.company_id AND lower(c.name) LIKE #{kw} ESCAPE '\') OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM position p JOIN position_category pc ON pc.id = p.category_id WHERE p.id = i.position_id AND ( lower(p.name) LIKE #{kw} ESCAPE '\' OR lower(pc.name) LIKE #{kw} ESCAPE '\')) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM interview_tag it JOIN tag t ON t.id = it.tag_id WHERE it.interview_id = i.id AND lower(t.name) LIKE #{kw} ESCAPE '\')

ORDER BY (SELECT r.interview_date FROM interview_round r WHERE r.interview_id = i.id AND r.interview_date IS NOT NULL ORDER BY r.interview_date, r.interview_date_precision LIMIT 1) DESC NULLS LAST, i.id ASC
mapper.select:
SELECT i.id FROM interview_record i
LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT c.id, c.name, count(i.id) AS cnt FROM company c JOIN interview_record i ON i.company_id = c.id WHERE 1=1
GROUP BY c.id, c.name ORDER BY count(i.id) DESC, c.id ASC

SELECT p.category_id AS categoryId, pc.name AS name, count(*) AS cnt FROM interview_record i JOIN position p ON p.id = i.position_id JOIN position_category pc ON pc.id = p.category_id WHERE 1=1
GROUP BY p.category_id, pc.name, pc.sort_order ORDER BY pc.sort_order

SELECT i.recruit_type AS recruit_type, count(*) AS cnt FROM interview_record i WHERE 1=1
GROUP BY i.recruit_type

SELECT i.id, i.department, i.recruit_type, c.id AS c_id, c.name AS c_name, p.id AS p_id, p.name AS p_name, pc.name AS p_category, fd.interview_date AS first_date, fd.interview_date_precision AS first_precision FROM interview_record i JOIN company c ON c.id = i.company_id LEFT JOIN position p ON p.id = i.position_id LEFT JOIN position_category pc ON pc.id = p.category_id LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT r.interview_date, r.interview_date_precision FROM interview_round r WHERE r.interview_id = i.id AND r.interview_date IS NOT NULL ORDER BY r.interview_date, r.interview_date_precision LIMIT 1 ) fd ON true WHERE i.id IN #{id} AND
SELECT interview_id, round_type, round_no, remark FROM interview_round WHERE interview_id IN #{id} ORDER BY interview_id, sort_order
SELECT it.interview_id, t.name FROM interview_tag it JOIN tag t ON t.id = it.tag_id WHERE it.interview_id IN #{id} ORDER BY it.interview_id, it.tag_id

SELECT r.interview_id AS iid, q.id AS qid, r.round_type AS round_type, r.round_no AS round_no, r.remark AS round_remark, q.content AS content, q.algorithm_description AS algo_desc, q.algorithm_requirements AS algo_req FROM question q JOIN interview_round r ON r.id = q.round_id WHERE r.interview_id IN #{id} ORDER BY r.interview_id, r.sort_order, q.sort_order

SELECT f.question_id AS qid, f.id AS fid, f.content AS content FROM follow_up f JOIN question q ON q.id = f.question_id JOIN interview_round r ON r.id = q.round_id WHERE r.interview_id IN #{id} ORDER BY f.question_id, f.sort_order
